verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents its own native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Slack, Figma and 'other tools'. That is a real first-party integration capability, but there is no evidence of an app marketplace or of thousands of connectable tools. The REST API for building custom integrations is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an app marketplace or directory, evidence of integration breadth at the scale of thousands, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Seamless integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and other tools mean Shortcut updates while you work.
